summary: UPDATE 4 (secret 733T code Easter egg) fully verified on mobile viewport 430x920 via Playwright against public preview URL. All 9 required scenarios PASS: (1) Fresh state - CODE label shown, roadman/king/gym/tourist/fancy show 'UNLOCK COMING SOON' with no select-pigeon button; classic/business selectable. No leet-badge. (2) Overlay opens on tap of open-code-button and CANCEL closes with no state change. (3) Three wrong codes ('abcd','1234','zzzz') each returned distinct cheeky lines ('ABSOLUTE NONSENSE.', 'THE PIGEONS KNOW.', 'INCORRECT, HUMAN.') — all members of the WRONG[] pool — with no celebration and label remains 'CODE'. (4) Lowercase '733t' correctly triggered celebration (leet-achieved 'LEET PIGEON STATUS ACHIEVED' + leet-unlocked 'ALL PIGEONS UNLOCKED' + Confetti/Audio.leet), COO! (leet-done) closed it; menu label flipped to '1337'. (5) Pigeons screen after unlock: leet-badge '1337' visible in header; every pigeon (roadman/king/gym/tourist/fancy/business/classic) shows select-pigeon button — no 'UNLOCK COMING SOON', no lock overlay — and all are selectable. (6) Persistence: full page reload keeps label '1337', localStorage key dp_leetUnlock='1', pigeon screen still shows leet-badge and fancy remains unlocked. (7) PLAY still starts a normal run (flap-area rendered) — Easter-egg overlay does not interfere with gameplay entry. Case-insensitivity confirmed via lowercase submit (code.trim().toUpperCase()==='733T'). No JS errors during the whole flow (only harmless RN-web deprecation warnings for shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents style props).

issues: 'CODE' label uses very dim colour rgba(199,184,230,0.5) at 12px — this is intentional (Easter egg should be subtle) per spec, so acceptable, but note contrast is low on the bg. Not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: SecretCode.js:28 correct case-insensitive check via code.trim().toUpperCase()==='733T'. Verified with lowercase '733t' successfully triggering celebrate view.
SecretCode.js:34 wrong-code path picks uniformly from WRONG[7]. All observed messages were members of the pool. Spec did not require anti-repeat, so acceptable.
SecretCode.js:39-44 close() resets code/error/celebrate state — good hygiene so re-opening starts clean.
MainMenu.js:48 label toggle based on leetUnlock prop works; testID 'open-code-button' preserved after unlock (still queryable) — spec compliant.

PigeonsScreen.js:12 isUnlocked additive override (!p.locked || leetUnlock || unlockedPigeons.includes(p.id)) — original PIGEONS.locked flags untouched, architecture preserved. Verified: fresh session still shows locked pigeons before code entry.
App.js:71-74 handleLeetUnlock updates state AND persists via Persistence.setLeet(true). loadAll() consumes dp_leetUnlock === '1' → boolean, verified on reload.
persistence.js:11,42,55 dp_leetUnlock key correctly wired; setLeet is fire-and-forget with catch — consistent with other setters.

Non-blocking: TextInput has autoCapitalize='characters' so typed lowercase visually appears uppercase, but underlying value from onChangeText is what react-native-web reports; validation upper-cases explicitly, so both display and logic are safe.
seed_data_creation: localStorage cleared before fresh-state assertions; dp_leetUnlock='1' created by 733t submission and verified persistent.

TextInput data-testid='code-input' works with page.fill(); autoCapitalize does not block programmatic values. Overlay uses onStartShouldSetResponder — force=True on clicks is fine as shown.
